With an emphasis on the model's ability to predict days with rather heavy and heavy rainfall, this study also evaluates the model's performance using a variety of statistical measures including Mean Absolute Error(MAE), Root Mean Square Error(RMSE) and Coefficient of determination(R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) error. The encouraging findings of the present study implies that LSTM may prove to be a good substitute for traditional techniques in the North Himalayan region when it comes to rainfall forecasting. The present study adds to the increasing amount of research on the use of advanced machine learning algorithms for weather forecasting and emphasizes the importance of incorporating these methods into local climate adaptation strategies.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Expert System and Higher Order Thinking Skills: A Brief Review
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: This review paper explores the integration of AI, mainly AI based Expert System in education sector that foster Higher order thinking skills. AI has become integral to advanced methods of education, immediate feedback, personalized learning experiences, self- paced learning and capabilities of assessment. Human-like decision ability has been noticed in AI based Expert system which promotes critical thinking, creativity and metacognition. By increasing ‘Human-AI-co reasoning’ these expert systems engage the learners through inquiry-based methods, helping to deepen learning and understanding without direct explanations. Related researches demonstrates that AI based Expert System enhance performance of students and positively affect their cognitive skills through individualized educational support. This review paper focusses on qualitative and quantitative results of AI integration, presenting its potential to increase Higher Order Thinking Skills of students and also reduce the burden of teachers. But the challenge is, AI cannot substitute teachers/facilitators; work as a valuable supporter in teaching learning scenario. This paper summarizes the integration of expert systems in education provides opportunities to promote self - paced learning and improve Higher order thinking skills. The AI based Technologies promise revolution in education, but further exploration is required to balance out their potential limitations and advantages, conforming optimal use of AI technologies in fostering Higher order thinking abilities among learners.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of ANN-based MPPT Included in Grid Feeding Inverter
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: This study compares the Perturb and Observe (P&O) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) based MPPT approaches for grid-connected photovoltaic system. The aim is identifying methods that provide increased efficiency in the solar energy extraction process which has drawn a lot of researchers to photovoltaic (PV) cells. Due to nonlinear behavior of PV, its output depends on variables such as ambient irradiance and solar temperature. The MPPT techniques are employed to maximize the PV cell's output power. This study addresses advanced and standard MPPT approaches for comparison, and the results demonstrate that the ANN-based MPPT technique provides improved performance as compared to the conventional P&O. Bayesian Regularization (BR) method is used to train the ANN. The comparison between the conventional P&O method and ANN based MPPT method is carried out at various atmospheric conditions and the results are included in the paper. Additionally, the 4.5kW single-phase transformer-less grid-connected ANN-based MPPT model has been developed in MATLAB/SIMULINK, and the efficacy of ANN-based MPPT is evaluated.

articleTitle: Hybrid Explainable DL Framework for Securing Smart Critical Infrastructure Using CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Smart Critical Infrastructure (SCI) encompasses a wide range of essential systems, including power grids, water management facilities, and transportation networks. These interconnected systems form the backbone of modern societies, enabling efficient resource distribution and urban management. However, the integration of SCIs with communication systems, while enhancing their capabilities, has also introduced significant security vulnerabilities. To address these security challenges, artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising solution. Yet, the complexity of AI models often hinders their adoption in critical scenarios where decision-making transparency is crucial. This paper proposes an explainable LSTM-CNN-based hybrid framework for securing SCIs, combining the strengths of both architectures while providing interpretability of results. Our novel approach leverages Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for feature extraction and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for temporal analysis. To enhance explainability, we employ state-of-the-art techniques such as LIME, SHAP, and LRP. Performance evaluation of the framework demonstrates its effectiveness, with metrics including accuracy, loss, F1 score (weighted and macro), precision, and recall. The results indicate superior security threat detection capabilities while offering insights into the decision-making process, thus enabling more informed and trustworthy implementation in SCI environments.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Controlling of Hexane Sedimentation in Oil Extraction Process
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The rice bran oil extraction process includes the formation of pellets or bran powder by the sowing process then it is sent to the solvent container. Hexane will be added to the solvent container. Hexane is a universal solvent to extract the oil from rice pellets and powder. After the addition of hexane, the oil will be filtered and the excess hexane will be collected and reused for the same process. The excess hexane undergoes condensation, and evaporation and is sent to the cooling tower for reusing it as the solvent. As it is a cyclic process the hexane will be sprayed 4 to 5 times to extract oil from the bran powder. The problem arises when it exceeds 2 times of cyclic process then the time taken to hexane to filter out the oil will get higher. The extraction property of hexane will be reduced so that it will get sedimented over the bran powder. The sedimentation of the hexane over the bran makes the process slower and there will be a manual operator to look out whether it is sedimented or not. After that, the control action will be taken to control the flow of hexane to the container.

Author Keywords: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN, pH sensor and Conductivity sensor

articleTitle: Designing an Efficient Product Image Classification Framework Using Adaptive YoloV5 with Long Short-Term Memory in E-Commerce Platform
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Presently, the online store supports the customers to buy the desired products in online. So, huge competitions are developed in the Electronic Commerce (E-commerce) sector for developing the technology. Most of the E-commerce platforms represent the particular products that users enquire about and also display other similar objects also to improve the interest among the online customers. As the online platforms hold more variety of products, it is essential to analyze the similar products sold together, and also its recommendation is needed. Sentimental analysis plays a major role in opinion mining, which helps to enhance product recommendations to online users. Every day enormous data are generated in the E-commerce and the data are utilized by online retailers to identify customer expectations. Using enormous resources, sentimental analysis models process multiple online options. Hence, it is important to construct a new product image classification technique for the E-commerce platform by considering the limitations of existing techniques. At first, essential images are acquired from standard sources. The gathered images are provided to the product image classification phase. Here, effective product image classification procedures are executed using a developed framework named Adaptive YoloV5 with Long Short-Term Memory (A-YoloV5-LSTM). Also, the weights and hyper-parameters are tuned using Beluga Whale Optimization (BWO). Further, the efficiency of the recommended product image classification technique is validated over different performance metrics.

Author Keywords: Adaptive YoloV5 with Long Short Term Memory

articleTitle: Area and Power Modeling of FPGA Based Binary-to-Gray Code Converter Circuit for Rotary Encoder
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The rotary encoders are crucial components of many precision control systems and using gray codes in such systems helps ensure accurate positional data. Hence, it is imperative to efficiently convert binary data to gray code in order to reduce tracking errors. Area and power being two main design constraints for digital circuits need to be estimated. Even though the current commercial tools can be used to make these estimates, doing so takes more time because complete design cycles need to be followed. Accurately estimating resource usage and power dissipation early in the design process while working under tight deadline is therefore one of the biggest challenges for designers. None of the existing literature address the modeling of area and power for binary-to-gray converter circuits. This paper proposes area and power estimation models of Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) based binary-to- gray code converter circuits. The converter circuits are described using very high-speed integrated circuit hardware description language (VHDL), and synthesized using Vivado 2014.2 tool targeted to Zynq family FPGAs device (xc7z020clg484-1). The proposed models are developed in MATLAB Curve Fit tool using regression approach of machine learning. Using the proposed models, the FPGA resource utilization and power dissipation of binary-to-gray code converter circuits are predicted and compared with the reports obtained using Vivado tool. The low values of estimation error obtained in all cases demonstrate the high accuracy of proposed area and power models.

articleTitle: Leveraging Antiviral Lectins for Developing Glycan-Based Vaccines by Employing Standard and AI-Driven Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: In last three decades, astounding research data on antiviral lectins has been generated and their potential in playing a significant role in controlling emerging viruses like SARS-CoV-2 is being acknowledged. With recent research revealing the change in conformation of spike protein after fusion with the host cell, it is believed that vaccines developed against epitopes of pre-fusion conformation may not be as effective as was earlier anticipated. Besides, on the other hand, AI based tools can address the issue of struggling with rapidly-changing viruses by enabling precise glycan modeling, optimizing delivery methods, and improving host defence through glycan editing. This work focuses on the diverse physiological roles of lectins, with functional details of various antiviral lectins and the role various members of this class may play in strengthening the interaction with glycan based viral epitopes. Besides, AI-driven techniques discussed herein may provide significant mileage in facilitating the development of glycan-based vaccines that employ lectins with specificity against the viral epitopes. The recently characterized envelope glycans of SARS-CoV-2 are being discussed as a case in point.

articleTitle: Optimal Treatment Planning in Real-Time Using AI and Multi-Objective Optimization for Chronic Disease Management
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The rapid increase of global health burden from chronic diseases, like type 2 diabetes, hypertension, cancer, etc. Developing an individualized treatment plan for these diseases is fundamental to improving patient prognosis. Unfortunately, traditional treatment planning takes a long time, and it can be an expensive process that might not consider the particular patient requirements/preferences. This study aims to develop a novel method involving artificial intelligence (AI) and multi-objective optimization-based treatment planning using real-time data. The authors suggested a tool for combining clinical data, patient-specific information, and treatment guidelines to build personalized interventions aligned with medical efficacy and the preferred trade-offs from patients. This AI will work at processing the data for each patient on an ongoing basis and updating treatment plans in real time to ensure they stay dynamic and adaptive. In addition, the multi-objective optimization approach will enable better plan tailoring to patient-specific objectives regarding quality of life, medication compliance, and cost-effectiveness. This project's projected impacts are considerable and can transform chronic disease management by improving treatment effectiveness, reducing patient and selfmanagement burdens and burden on healthcare systems with overall improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Optimizing Health and Fitness Monitoring: An Advanced Smartwatch Alert System for Comprehensive Lifestyle Management
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: This Android software will provide a real-time heart-tracking system through a smartwatch. It is very helpful for people suffering from cardiac issues and also for elderly people. In this, you can customise a range for your heart during the time of set up, and it gives an emergency warning whenever you exceed the limit as the smartwatch monitors it all the time. When the user experiences an abnormal heart rate, it informs all the pre-designated emergency contacts along with your location through SMS. This feature ensures the quick safety of the user by informing it about the right people. This solution has improved the safety of people who are at risk of heart-related problems through the health monitoring system and its advanced emergency system. This advanced smartwatch alert system given to people will make sure that they and their loved ones are safe by enabling the efficient prompt and emergency medical system.

articleTitle: A Comparative Evaluation of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches for Abdominal Disease Detection via Wrist Pulse Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: This study describes a unique method for tracking one's health that applies deep learning and machine learning algorithms to wrist pulse data from wearables using photoplethysmography (PPG) sensors. Continuous health monitoring is becoming more practical as wearable technology becomes more widely used. A rich source of physiological data, wrist pulse data provides a non-invasive way to evaluate cardiovascular health, stress levels, and general well-being. This paper explores the creation and use of sophisticated machine learning and deep learning models for the interpretation of wrist pulse data. Various health metrics, such as pulse rate, blood pressure, stress levels, and even early symptoms of cardiovascular diseases, may be predicted using these models, which are made to extract significant characteristics, spot trends, and do so. This work investigates the capability of machine learning and deep learning architectures to manage the temporal and spatial complexity present in wrist pulse data. The findings of this research show how well machine learning and deep learning techniques work for precisely tracking health factors utilizing wrist pulse data and detecting various numbers of abdominal diseases with the highest accuracy of 98.7 %, sensitivity, specificity, and precision of 91.9, 96.1, and 93.8 per cent respectively. The minimum time taken by one of the models was 346 seconds, with an accuracy of 97.6%.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Examination of Depression Detection Through Multimedia Content on Social Media Platforms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Depression is a mental health disorder that causes persistent feelings of sadness, hopelessness, and a loss of interest or pleasure in activities that one used to enjoy. It can be caused by a combination of genetic, biological, environmental, and psychological factors. Identifying depression causes in social media involves the use of data mining and natural language processing techniques to analyze user-generated content and behavior. Depression analysis is a popular research topic in the natural language processing field, and researchers are increasingly publishing papers on this subject. This review paper aims to explore the use of machine learning techniques for depression analysis using social media text, audio, and video data. The paper provides an overview of the different machine learning techniques used for depression analysis and their effectiveness. The review paper can help researchers understand the current state of knowledge on depression analysis using social media text, images, and videos along with machine learning techniques and identify potential areas for future research.

articleTitle: Hybrid Multi-Task CNN Framework with Expert Labels for Advanced Document Forgery Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The method of Document forgery has full-size demanding situations in daily life, impacting diverse sectors by way of compromising the authenticity by jeopardizing the legitimacy of important files. In a survey of over 400 lending professionals conducted by the fintech company Plaid, 61% of lending organizations identified themselves as victims of document fraud. Of these, 42<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> of cases involved fraudulent documents that had alterations in financial details such as bank balances, and transaction amounts, while 50% of documents had identity details altered (identity theft). This paper addresses this issue by offering a novel and a hybrid technique for forgery detection for both digital and handwritten documents using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). Our method treats forgery detection as an image segmentation undertaking, leveraging the skills of CNNs to correctly pick out and delineate suspicious regions within any form of report, whether or not digital or handwritten. By posing forgery detection as segmentation trouble, we enhance the precision of our version in distinguishing between genuine and forged regions. In addition, to improve detection accuracy, our technique integrates multi-task mastering with the aid of incorporating auxiliary labels generated via a text detection model. This model produces bounding boxes around textual content, which can be used as extra labels at some point in training, permitting the CNN to study relevant functions for each text and forgery detection. The hybrid nature of our model guarantees robust overall performance throughout diverse report types, demonstrating its effectiveness in addressing the complexities of record forgery in sensible eventualities.

articleTitle: When Human Meets AI: The Study of Association Between AI and Humans
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into Human Resource Management (HRM) is transforming organisational practices with the expectation of enhancing effectiveness, innovation and strategic adaption. This paper explores the multifaceted impacts of AI in HRM with industry leader insights coupled with scholarly research. This paper synthesizes existing literature and empirical studies. The paper spells out the challenges, opportunities, and innovative solutions emerging from the application of AI into HRM. The paper also offers insight into the dynamic field of AI-driven HRM practices. The paper will examine how AI is influencing HRM, involving upskilling and preparedness to leverage benefits. The study reveals the relation between AI in HRM and improvement in the employee experience and engagement, thus promoting more value adding outcomes in organizational success and flexibility. Further, it discusses how technologies such as big data, blockchain, robotics and machine learning change the nature of HR practices. The paper presents a framework of how AI evolves in HR and applies statistical tests that demonstrate AI's impact on HR practices. In the final analysis, this is a very useful source that can be used to provide valuable insights and recommendations to HR professionals and researchers as they navigate the future of AI in HRM, which further continues to promote innovation, employee satisfaction, and organizational effectiveness.

articleTitle: Exploring Machine Learning Approaches for Future Disease Prediction in Gynecology: An Experimental Study
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: This study delves into the potential of machine learning in the early detection of cervical cancer, a condition that remains one of the most significant health burdens in resource-limited settings, where delays and inaccuracies in diagnostics frequently lead to adverse outcomes. Utilizing a dataset of 858 patients treated at the Universitario de Caracas Hospital, the research evaluates various supervised learning models, including Support Vector Machines, Decision Trees, and Random Forests, to predict risk factor classifications in cervical cancer. The methodology incorporates data preprocessing, feature selection, and cross-validation using the caret package to ensure the results are robust, reliable, and reproducible. Among the models tested, Random Forest demonstrated superior performance, achieving the highest scores in accuracy, precision, and recall, making it the most effective tool in this study. Critical risk factors such as age, lifestyle, and medical history were highlighted through visual tools like feature importance heat maps and confusion matrices, emphasizing their role in predictive accuracy. This research underscores the pressing need for innovative technological solutions that assist healthcare professionals in diagnostic and treatment planning processes, particularly in under-resourced areas. By leveraging machine learning, these diagnostic gaps can be bridged, enabling timely interventions and significantly improving patient outcomes. Moreover, the findings illuminate the broader transformative potential of machine learning, not only in gynecological health but also in expanding predictive diagnostics to other medical domains, thereby revolutionizing healthcare systems on a global scale.

articleTitle: AI-Assisted Fine-Grained Plant Disease Diagnosis from Smartphone Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Disease detection at an early stage in plants is very important in order to check serious losses to crop production. This research presents novel, lightweight, and easily portable AI model that is best suited for real-time plant disease detection through mobile technology. The model is a combination of MobileNet and EfficientNet, and the Model is trained from the PlantVillage Dataset. One of the main objectives of the study is to enhance the ability to distinguish between visually similar diseases, a universal problem of plant pathology. Lack of data is then solved by using transfer learning from pre-trained networks as well as further image augmentation. Further, optimization techniques are employed in work to get faster inference and minimal device usage on mobile platform but keeping the diagnostic accuracy high. Thus, the proposed approach helps to bring ideas of AI to practicle field usage and supports further progress in such industries as precision farming and food safety.

articleTitle: Ai-Driven Sustainability: Exploring Historical Developments, Applications, and Future Horizons
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence has now emerged as one of the most powerful tools to tackle various sustainability issues from climate change and resource management to environmental degradation. The historical development, applications, and future horizons of AI-driven sustainability are researched in this paper, focusing on some of the significant contributions made in sectors ranging from energy and agriculture to urban planning. Industries will be able to optimize resource use, enhance energy efficiency, and introduce sustainable practices with the help of AI technologies such as machine learning, deep learning, and big data analytics. Several other relevant issues regarding the integration of AI include data privacy, biases, limitation of infrastructure, and regulatory uncertainties. The latest innovations in AI, such as quantum computing and bio-inspired algorithms, show promise in pursuit of sustainability goals. The paper reiterates the need for cross-sectoral collaboration, responsible development, and strategic governance in unleashing the maximum positive impact of AI on global sustainability.

articleTitle: Leveraging Transfer Learning for Potato Crop Disease Classification: A Comparative Study of AI Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Potato is one of the most important crops for our world and protection from diseases is a must for this crop. This study uses transfer learning method with models like MobileNetV2, ResNet50V2, DenseNet121, EfficientNetB0, to develop a detection model for potato crop disease detection. We evaluated their performance using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score on a dataset made available by Kaggle.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Software Development Effort Estimation via Computational Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: In software development, software engineering is reducing failure in development process. Before software development life cycle use 80% development suffer from cost and time factors. In SDLC processes Analysis phase calculate effort estimation by the system analysist because before development if team know about cost of project then failure chance will reduce. Effort estimation play a critical role for calculating effort in term of person/hour and time required. Basically traditional approach like COCOMO, FCP SLIM etc are used to calculate effort estimation. But if we want to calculate in automated form then Machine Learning approach are required. In Machine Learning ANN, SVR, Bayesian Network etc used for Effort Estimation. Machine Learning framework used the Data sets for estimating Effort. So high quality Datasets are required. Accuracy of effort estimation is directly proportional to Datasets in machine learning technique. In this paper we review the Data sets used in Machine Learning for Software Effort Estimation. and find which dataset is provide better result.

articleTitle: Phase-Based EEG Analysis for Enhanced Imagined Speech Decoding in Brain-Computer Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) enable direct communication between the brain and external devices. It provides possibilities for neurorehabilitation and assistive technologies. This study focuses on imagined speech, a challenging yet rising domain in BCI research, to decode inner speech signals from EEG data. Imagined speech aims to translate inner speech or imagined words into actionable signals without requiring overt muscle activity. Imagined speech decoding faces significant challenges, including low signal-to-noise ratios, complex inter-subject variability, and the difficulty of isolating distinct neural patterns related to specific imagined words. Phase-based feature extraction is explored to address these obstacles. The phase- based information of EEG signals, is more robust to amplitude fluctuations and noise interference. Extensive preprocessing is applied to filter out and isolate artifacts effectively. Phase-based features are then extracted from the preprocessed signals, and a machine learning model is applied to classify imagined speech accurately. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the phase-based method, showing improved accuracy in imagined word classification over traditional approaches. Hence, phase-based analysis is a powerful tool for advancing BCI performance in imagined speech applications.

articleTitle: Eye Disease Detection and Classification using Deep Learning: A Review
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The paper reviews recent applications of deep learning techniques for eye disease classification. The study aims to assess and compare the performance of various convolutional neural network architectures on retinal image datasets, focusing on metrics such as accuracy, precision, and recall. Some of these architectures are benchmarked on the same dataset to evaluate their performance in similar setups. Findings indicate that models like DenseN et and ResN et offer high accuracy while requiring large datasets for effective generalization. The study also highlights research gaps, such as the need for multi-label classification models, Explainable AI for clinical adoption, transfer learning for cross-domain data and more diverse datasets. These findings provide a foundation for developing more robust and scalable automated computer-aided eye disease detection solutions.

articleTitle: AI for Economics: Innovative Approaches with Machine Learning to Predict Upcoming Recession
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The recent adoption of machine learning and artificial intelligence tools in economic studies has improved the capacity of predicting recessions. It is making predictions more accurate and exact. This project favors the application of state-of-the-art machine learning techniques to predict latent recessions from a number of macroeconomic, market, financial and global data sources. This work is guided by the practical application of advanced machine learning algorithm ie neural network, Support vector machine, Random forest, ensemble techniques among others which illustrate that such techniques are capable of discovering complex patterns and identifying threat signals which traditional methods cannot. The most successful recession prediction techniques are those ascertained through several Machine Learning model comparisons in this project. In the results, it will be seen that the application of ML models is much better than that of using econometric theory for predicting downturns in the economy which will be very helpful information for the governments or institutions such as banks and even investors. This information allows creating policies in advance so that the adverse consequences of the recession are lessened, improving the economic strength and stability. In addition, the project covers the ethical issues and potential challenges in deploying AI for economic forecasting and recommends the need for supplementing human judgment with machines. In conclusion, this project presents a vision of economic forecasting that has been revolutionized by AI and ML, and shows how this vision could eventually lead to better economic policies. The work will also serve as a foundation for further research to improve these models and broaden their use in different areas of the economy.

articleTitle: Big Data Analytics and Real-Time Optimization Using Hybrid Ant-Bee Colony Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: the supply chain industry has witnessed a boom since big data analytics and real-time optimization received an increasing demand for the availability of vast amounts of image data. The traditional optimization algorithms need to scale better with the complexity and data size, so arriving at solutions that are in is time-consuming. One of the relevant solutions is hybridizing ant-bee colony algorithms that mix the benefits from two optimization methods, such as those shown in bee and ant colonies. Ant-bee colony algorithms are an example of how nature-based probabilistic methods can find the most optimal solutions in optimized ways. Ants explore and exploit solutions in tandem, assisting each other to navigate the entire search space; bees focus on small sets of candidate points identified by ants whose HQI doses are already optimized. Stochastic geometry and deterministic search give us access to a good balance between behavior explorations (for diversity, exploitation) in the space of solutions, leading to faster convergence toward better results. These algorithms have successfully applied to various real-world applications, including supply chain management, resource allocation, and transportation planning. It has been demonstrated to work better than classical optimization methods in convergence and full-scale solution computing. In addition, they are real-time algorithms that can be applied to dynamic and static data applications. As a result, the hybrid ant-bee colony algorithms would offer user-friendly and effective mechanisms to tackle big data analytics and real-time optimization operations. They can solve complex problems in several industries, and this ability makes them an excellent tool for business decision-making and process improvement.

articleTitle: Dual-Node LoRa-Enabled Obstacle Detection and Rider Notification System for Enhancing Safety in Two-Wheeler Vehicles with Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Over the past several years, road safety especially for two-wheeler riders who are more susceptible to accidents in a traffic situation. One of the major problems that make it difficult to ensure the safety of the riders is the lack of effective real time sensors that can detect potential collision obstructions which include other roving vehicles in hidden areas such as the lateral or the distal areas. Although there are certain improvements in vehicle technology, two-wheeler riders are still ill-equipped with sufficient tools to perceive potentially overhanging dangers, hence exposing them to higher chances of encountering road hazards. The integrated system proposes a novel method for rider's obstacle awareness and protection by using the radio communication technologies to offer real time warning of the presence of the obstacles. In this system, warning of the possible hindrances is given to the rider by scanning the area around the rider for the presence of the intruding hindrances mostly from the front and back of the rider's location. Utilizing a long range and low power communication technologies helps maintain error free parameters between interconnected components of the system hence delivering fast alerts to the riders without the riders straining their eyes to search the area. Moreover, this system has been deployed onto a cloud platform which allows for remote safety notifications as well as data availability for riders on or off the roads. Consequently, such remote access enhances the features of the system by providing real time insights and alerts through mobile applications, thereby improving the user experience. There is a great need to bring together elements of wireless communication and real-time data processing in this system which considerably addresses rider safety in a workable and economical form. It is expected that this particular technology will help to reduce accidents, increase good riding practices and enhance safety for two-wheel riders in different driving environments. The system takes us one step closer to a situation where every road user will feel as if advancements in safety technologies have been made available to them, making their riding experience safer.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Comparative Analysis of One, Four, and Fourteen Channel EEG Vowel Datasets
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) have substantially enhanced the interaction between humans and computers. Particularly, benefiting individuals with speech impairments who can use the BCIs for communication, underscoring the importance of this research domain. In this study, we explore the classification of imagined vowels through the decoding of neural signals from the brain using Electroencephalography (EEG) technology with lower channel EEG devices and then compare the obtained results. A new EEG dataset is formed specifically for this research, utilizing a single, four and fourteen- channel non-invasive EEG device that records brain signals while a subject imagines a vowel. Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Genetic Programming (GP), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Random Forest (RF) machine learning (ML) algorithms were utilized to classify the generated vowel datasets. Confusion matrix-based results were obtained for all models. Comparison of results demonstrated that LSTM produces the highest classification accuracy of 93.8% for fourteen channels and 92.2% for four channel datasets whereas, for single channel dataset Random Forest classifier gives the best results with an accuracy of 83.44%. Other performance parameters like sensitivity, precision, specificity, F1 score were also compared to find the most suitable classifier for lower channel datasets among the four classifiers under study. The whole idea of this research lies in finding the utility of classifiers for datasets of devices with lesser electrodes. As lower channel devices can be conveniently used by people under medical trails and may one day replace bulky devices.

articleTitle: Digital Twins for Scaling Electrical Startups Through AI-Driven Recommender Systems and Tokenized Energy Markets: A Vision for Future
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The scaling up of the electrical energy sector in general, and the new startups focusing on renewable energy sources-wind, solar, and energy storage-requires the latest technology to solve challenges related to scaling and operational efficiency. Digital Twins, AI-driven recommender systems, and tokenized energy markets form a base for innovative solutions that strengthen operational capabilities and competitiveness. Digital Twins offer real-time monitoring, data analysis, and predictive maintenance of energy assets, enabling startups to optimize production, asset management, and reduce costs. AIdriven recommender systems use historical and real-time data to improve decision-making by offering strategies in the areas of energy management, production, and resource allocation. The integration of AI supports a startup in foreseeing changes in demand and making real-time adjustments toward profitability and sustainability. Tokenized energy markets, powered by blockchain, are decentralized energy trading where energy assets are converted into digital tokens traded in peer-to-peer markets. This opens new revenue streams for startups in the creation of value pools and participation in decentralized energy exchanges, bypassing traditional intermediaries. Tokenization further promotes transparency and security of transactions, building trust between market participants. This paper explores how these technologies, i.e., This includes digital twins, AIdriven recommender systems, and tokenized energy markets, driving rapid scalability, cost efficiency, and market access for electrical startups to identify challenges and prospects of AIenhanced decentralized energy ecosystems.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach of Deep Convolution Neural Network and Transfer Learning for Tuberculosis Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Low and middle-income countries (LMICs) grapple with various difficulties in their campaign to curb the tuberculosis (TB) outbreak, including persistent socioeconomic health inequities, a lack of medical professionals in the field, and inadequate healthcare systems in underdeveloped areas. The rate of tuberculosis-related deaths is rising, and the causes of treatment failure remain unclear. In the healthcare industry, predictive algorithms also known as machine learning and information analysis approaches have shown to be helpful in identifying correlations between various characteristics that may influence a disease's course. The procedure of diagnosing tuberculosis has accelerated due to the advancement of computer technology. Machine learning and data analytics approaches have proven useful in the healthcare sector for determining connections between different features that could impact the course of a disease. Our work proposes a Hybrid strategy to handle unbalanced, less-category X-ray images, utilizing deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in conjunction with transfer learning. We examine the efficacy and efficiency of random sampling method for training neural networks and discover that it has a remarkable influence on the classification of medical images. Our techniques and findings point to a possible route for quicker and more precise TB diagnosis in LMIC medical facilities.

articleTitle: Exploring Transformers for Scalable Summarization of Long Documents
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The matter of document summarization pertains to the sub-field of Natural Language Processing or NLP, and it is instrumental in numerous industries and sectors. It can be used in many applications like journalism, research, legal documentation, etc. to quickly understand large documents without losing any relevant details. Advances in technology have so far brought transformer models to enrich the capabilities of long document summarization. Transformers are capable of capturing better dependencies from sequential information than other recurrent learning units like RNN and LSTM. Therefore, this paper is highly recommended for reviewing the architectures, approaches, strengths and weaknesses of top existing transformer models since it surveys the main existing models on this topic. A comparison of several transformer models, methodologies, and performance metrics is presented in tabular form in the review, which could help scientists and engineers engaged in this line of research.

articleTitle: Motor Imagery and Motor Movement Detection in EEG for Advancing Assistive Device Functionality
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Brain-computer interface (BCI) allows direct communication between the brain and external devices. In this study, the motor movements (MM) of the left and right hands, along with the imagined motor movements of both hands, are investigated. One major issue is the variability and noise present in electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. Many existing machine learning (ML) methods require large datasets for accurate classi-fication. The motivation behind this study is to enhance BCI per-formance by improving the classification of motor-related EEG signals, which is crucial for applications like neurorehabilitation. This research contributes to the development of more effective BCI systems and supports individuals with physical impairments by enabling real-time interpretation of brain activity, ultimately facilitating improved neurorehabilitation strategies. The problem statement focuses on effectively classifying these signals while minimizing the impact of noise. To tackle these challenges, four key aspects of the BCI pipeline are explored: signal acquisition, preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification using various ML techniques. A robust experimental setup was designed using PsychoPy to capture high-quality EEG data, and extensive preprocessing was performed to filter out noise. Then an exhaustive exploratory data analysis and Signal Preprocessing was performed to filter out the noises and select relevant EEG channels present over the motor cortex for further processing. Findings indicate that the ML model achieved a promising accuracy of 74.7%, successfully distinguishing between motor imagery and actual movement signals. The novelty of this work lies in its unique experimental design and dataset recording, emphasizing the innovative use of ICA for feature extraction. It also introduces a systematic preprocessing pipeline to enhance the overall analysis.

articleTitle: An Overview of Quantum Cryptography Evolution From Classical Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Secure communication between senders and recipients is made easier by cryptography. Conventional encryption techniques rely on either publicly accessible keys or privately owned keys. The confidentiality of the message is placed in danger, though, as eavesdroppers can intercept these keys. Using a specific kind of quantum mechanics, quantum cryptography ensures that messages are sent with complete security. One of the main components is Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), which distributes random binary keys so that parties can identify possible listening devices. This paper also looks at classical cryptography, DES and some limits and application areas of quantum cryptography.

articleTitle: Gradient Boosting with Boltzmann Machines for Enhanced Cardiovascular Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: cardiovascular diseases are the cause of a great many deaths in the global arena and thus considerable health burden. Early detection is an important cause; however, present models fail to recognize the complex and nonlinear interactions within high-dimensional cardiovascular datasets. Traditional machine learning models like logistic regression or decision trees fail to capture interactions of high-dimensional features. Although advanced techniques like Gradient Boosting and Random Forest improve the accuracy of predictions, they are difficult to model large, high-dimensional data sets. Therefore, there is a need for a better and more robust model, which enhances both accuracy and scalability. Introduce Boltzmann Machines as basic learners in a gradient boosting framework to improve the predictability of cardiovascular disease. This would be a resultant model that would capture high-order dependencies and capture non-linear relationships which otherwise would have helped improve the prediction. The model uses the hybrid approach of Gradient Boosting and Boltzmann Machines to successfully process interactions of complex features. Support Vector Machines have also been employed for fine tuning of classification performance. The dataset consists of 70,000 patient records with age, blood pressure, cholesterol levels, etc. The pre-processing stage includes scaling, normalization, and feature selection based on the Random Forest importance scores. Preliminary results show better precision compared with the traditional Gradient Boosting models. The combination of Boltzmann machines with SVMs is proved to be superior; it may capture non-linear dependencies and thereby can better predict an early and earlier diagnosis of cardiovascular disease. Conclusion: Boltzmann machines combining support vector machines in gradient boosting is an effective way of predicting cardiovascular disease, overcoming shortcomings and holding good promise for clinical applications to enhance patient outcomes.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Multi-Dimensional Stochastic Process Modeling for QoS Analysis in 6G Networks Under Joint Fading and Dynamic Interference Constraints in $\alpha-\eta-\mu$ Environments
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate AI-enhanced multidimensional stochastic process modelling for QoS analysis in 6G networks subjected to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha-\eta-\mu$</tex> fading and dynamic interference constraints. Simulation results and heatmaps are utilized for the investigation of fading parameters such as shape factors and interference power, that impacts network performance. Our experimental findings show that AI-driven models provide markedly superior results in improving a number of QoS metrics, including throughput, latency, and packet loss compared to traditional methods. The research illustrates how AI improves connectivity, and operational stability of a network which adapts in times of fluctuating conditions. Our results demonstrate the ability of AI to preserve QoS while balancing performance and power, thereby providing a perspective for 6G network design and optimization.

articleTitle: Recent Trends in EV Technologies, Charging Process and Standards: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: In this era, the depletion of fossil fuels and rising concerns about the emission of greenhouse gases (GHGs), which has contribution 30-40% of green-house-gas (GHG) emission by fossil-fuel operated transportation systems only and creating serious issues to environmental and eco-systems. So, there is a rapid transition toward electric vehicles (EVs) transportation system and it is providing a significant role in ongoing and coming electric vehicle transportation system. It has a significant scope for new research and advancements. Electric vehicles do not produce any kind of pollution i.e. emission of gases, noise pollution and running economically. The electric vehicles (EVs) have exponential growth and recognized worldwide. The rapid growth of electric vehicles are facing different challenges i.e. technical advancement, charging infrastructures, distribution network bidirectional power flow and charging time. This paper comprises a vital review on infrastructure of EV, latest scenario in technical development, different electric vehicles, AC-DC chargers with different charging standards, AC-DC isolated and non-isolated converters details. Slow and fast chargers and their levels of charging power and connectors are to be analysed for improving charging methods. There will be some challenges and future scopes for further advancements in modern electric vehicle technology.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of 3Pl Logistics for Deteriorating Products: a Cnn Approach to Demand and Carbon Emission Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: In real world scenario, Accurate demand and carbon emission forecasting play a critical role for optimizing supply chain management and supporting sustainable business strategies. Specifically, when it comes to carbon emissions and time-sensitive patterns of demand forecasting of supply chain data. The traditional models like the random forest and decision tree often come up inadequate in expressing complex, non-linear relationships. This study presents a comparative analysis of machine learning based models to predict demand and carbon emission forecasting. We propose a novel methodology to transform the raw supply chain data to use it in Convolution neural network (CNN) model. These data are then classified into Low, Medium, High Categories. These categories are then predicted by using the Convolution neural network (CNN) model. This method has been evaluated with a comprehensive dataset and achieved overall accuracy of 73 % in demand forecasting and 80 % in carbon emission forecasting, which shows that it can capture complex trends and achieve significant accuracy for multivariate with 3 PL logistic system. This shows the potential advantages of the approach to traditional forecasting methods.

articleTitle: Review and Assessment of PV Panel Cooling for Performance Enhancement Using Nano- Enhanced Phase Change Materials (NePCMs)
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Global demand for efficient, effective, and sustainable energy solutions is increasing. Photovoltaic (PV) panels are widely used worldwide to meet this demand. Temperature rise due to solar irradiance causes significant deterioration in the efficiency of photovoltaic (PV) panels. Conventionally these panels have been cooled by various methods to receive the best performance such as passive cooling (includes heat sink, fins, and natural convection) and active cooling (includes water and forced air cooling) for the last fifteen years. Literature has found using few advanced methods of cooling to improve the performance of PV panels further. The PCM (phase change material) and NePCM (Nano enhanced phase change material) are found to be suggested as potential replacements for the traditional methods of cooling. The advantages of using PCM are sustainable cooling, temperature control during peak hours, cost-effectiveness, and compact size. The addition of nanoparticles in NePCM improves thermal conductivity and as a result heat transfer rate increase. This reduces the charging and discharging timings and improves the thermal performance of cooling. This paper reviews the techniques by which we can enhance the efficiency of PV panels. It includes a brief introduction to traditional cooling methods and it majorly focuses on PCM and NePCM-based cooling methods. The paper will highlight the benefits of these methods in improving the performance of PV panel cooling. Finally, it will also list the modifications that may be included in future research.

articleTitle: AI in Telecommunication: Revolutionizing Signal Processing and Communication Networks in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is revolutionising the telecommunications industry by enhancing signal processing, network management, and overall system performance. With the rise of 5G and IoT, AI has become a critical technology driving innovation and efficiency. AI algorithms have improved error correction, data compression techniques, and bandwidth allocation, ensuring networks can handle growing data traffic volumes. AI's ability to predict, analyse, and adapt to real-time data has improved network management capabilities, allowing more intelligent resource allocation, reduced latency, and increased network reliability. AI-driven network automation has enabled providers to shift from reactive to proactive management, minimising downtime and enhancing user experience. This shift boosts operational efficiency and reduces costs by enabling predictive maintenance and optimising energy consumption in data centres and network infrastructure. The future of telecommunications will be shaped by AI technologies like machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing, leading to advanced services like self-healing networks, real-time traffic management, and enhanced cybersecurity measures. As the telecommunication industry embraces AI-driven innovations, it will unlock new opportunities for growth and transform the everyday communication experience for billions of people worldwide.

articleTitle: Educating Empathetic Healthcare Systems with AI Technologies among Practitioners
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Empathy helps to contribute accurately to the precise healthcare user's circumstance. Empathy, or the ability to understand the patient's personal experience without associating with them, is a vital communication skill for a health professional. It has three dimensions: emotional, cognitive, and behavioral. It has been demonstrated that health workers with high levels of empathy work more efficiently to perform their roles. The empathic professional recognises the needs of healthcare consumers since they feel free to communicate their ideas and concerns. Although the importance of empathy cannot be emphasised, many health professionals struggle to integrate an empathic communication model into their daily practice. The chapter stresses empathy training for medical practitioners using cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence, as computer-aided technology in the form of care bots and chat-bots has begun to replace human carers. These technologies have the potential to both improve and reduce empathy in many healthcare systems.

articleTitle: A Pathway to Efficiency and Transparency of Indian Taxation System Through AI Technologies: NLP and Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: There are few Challenges in the Indian taxation system such as complexity, lack of efficiency & transparency, long procedure and compliances which makes it cumbersome. In this paper we will go through how these Challenges are faced out and overcome from it with the help of AI technologies such as natural language processing (NLP) and big data analytics. These technologies can play a transformative role in streamlining in the process of taxation. By implementing NLP, unstructured data like legal statutes, tax documents can be automatically processed, classified and interpreted. It contributes in improving the transparency, efficiency and user-friendly tax system. In parallel, big data analytics helps in detecting anomalies, reducing tax evasion and forecasting revenue collection by real time processing, advance pattern Recognition and predictive analysis. In this paper we include the various platforms for implementing these AI technologies in taxation system. We also discussed about process and applications of applying NLP & data analytics in Indian taxation system and how these technologies resolve the tax disputes of India. In this paper research methodologies involve secondary data of various good qualitative journal such as Scopus indexed and data from IEEE explore and real-world practical approaches for applying NLP and big data analytics in taxation system of India.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Secure and Privacy-Preserving Data Aggregation Scheme for Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Humans are intelligent beings, continually inventing new technologies that reduce manual effort and drive progress. Among these advancements, the smart grid stands out as a significant development in energy technology. A smart grid is an electrical network enhanced with sophisticated features such as high-power converters, automation tools, digitally controlled communication architecture, smart meters, and advanced energy management technologies. These components work together to improve the reliability and efficiency of power distribution. As smart meters become more common in households, electricity consumers are increasingly impacted by this technology. However, concerns have been raised about potential privacy violations, as smart meters collect personal data that may allow electricity providers to monitor customers' routines. In this paper, we have proposed a privacy-preserving and efficient data aggregation scheme in smart grids. In the proposed scheme we have implemented a multiple pseudonyms approach to protect users' privacy and for secure and efficient data aggregation, we leverage blockchain technology, while the Cuckoo filter is utilized for rapid user authentication. Analysis of our proposed scheme demonstrates that it provides better security, efficiency, and privacy than existing techniques.

articleTitle: Using ML to identify Fraudulent Activities in Healthcare Industry
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: This research belongs to comprehensive analysis of fraudulent activities going on in health care industry using machine learning. The study made a systematic approach in methodologies from various medical field. The systematic reviews and Meta analysis synthesizes the fraudulent in the health sector. This paper introduce few models like Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest, Logistic Regression. There are few parameters in the healthcare which impacts majority of the patient in the nationwide. Medicare fraud is a very serious issue where only old data sets and prediction are made which is also not 100% accurate. It only deals in prediction the more raw data the higher accuracy. Fraudulent activities in healthcare are increasing day by day which is a very big burden on the society. Patient multiple visits or routine checkup can also improve the prediction as they are also very well aware of the same. The research is all about detecting and preventing the fraud activities done in health care sector.

articleTitle: Automating the Future: User Insights on Smart Coworking Spaces
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Coworking space is paramount in the sharing economy, which means workspaces where users from different sectors work together to prevent isolation and share connectedness [1]; [2]; [3]. Coworking space is a physical location where individuals from diverse backgrounds, interests, and profiles work under one umbrella [4]. The scaling of the coworking spaces framework attracts users to work remotely in a flexible environment. Push motives behind the evolution of coworking spaces are a new trend of working, workspace in a good location, sustainability in terms of sharing facilities, services, equipment, accessibility, atmospherics, and a culture of inclusivity. These positive trends in coworking spaces are further enhanced by automation. With the rapid integration of technological advancements in coworking spaces, understanding how users perceive automation becomes pivotal for optimizing user experience and stimulating productive and comfortable work environments. Thus, the rationale of the study examines how users perceive automation in coworking spaces and how automation helps them in their tasks through surveys and interviews distributed to members of coworking spaces. Indeed, findings support the notion that measuring the perception of users is crucial for maximizing the benefits of automation and ensuring users' acceptance. The implications of the study can help coworking space providers in balancing automation with user preferences and perception, thus enhancing overall experience and engagement in evolving work environments.

articleTitle: An Intelligent IoT System for Health and Home Safety for Elderly People
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: It is normally a cause for concern to elderly people's families as they may develop complications and be left alone to struggle. Before, we proposed an intelligent watch-over system in elderly people's homes engaging a Raspberry Pi IoT device with built-in motion and temperature-humidity sensors. This system provided privacy protection and sent alerts on unusual activities through Twitter and, although useful, had some drawbacks; first of all, it was not very flexible and designed mainly for single-family homes. In the current paper, we introduce an enhanced version of our system that minimises these drawbacks by using additional sensors like pressure and sound sensors, as well as incorporating the wearable health monitoring systems. Besides, relying on the complex of sensors, the system now includes AI algorithms allowing the prediction of possible health problems and prompt notifications. With integration as a secure IoT platform adding effectiveness to communication protocol to realise reliable and real time notification of events through the LINE app. The sharpened system also comes integrated with a multi-user and multi-device environment which makes the system easily switch from being in a dormant state to being in watch-over mode depending on the people in the house. It is useful in elderly care in the current society since it does not only improve the security of the elderly and their physiological health but also offers consolation to their families.

articleTitle: Real-Time Load Forecasting and Demand Response Optimization Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The application of deep learning approaches for use in power system to enhance load forecasting accuracy is accurate real time load forecasting an essential element in managing the stability and efficiency of the power network. This research proposes a new deep learning-based architecture that improves STLP accuracy and directly provides input for demand response applications. Based on deep neural network, the proposed approach is able to capture temporal characteristics and non-linear relationship of the load data, and hence provides better performance of load forecasting in various operation conditions. Incorporation of these forecasts in real-time to manage demand response is shown to facilitate modulations of load in order to minimize costs of operation and at the same time ensure stability of power grid networks. The study shows that the implementation of this deep learning framework will go a long way in enhancing the stability of the contemporary power systems as the load forecasts are positively enhanced by demand response actions to achieve an enhanced supply of energy.

articleTitle: Cloud Computing in Healthcare Services
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Organizations are in consensus that cloud computing is going to shape the next decade and have a significant impact on numerous businesses and their practices. The effect of cloud technology in the healthcare business is yet to be determined, as the healthcare sector is complex, diverse, and unique, presenting hurdles such as safeguarding patient health archives while adhering to regulations set by compliance laws. Increasing the expenses of the healthcare industry is another challenge. Continuous efforts are ongoing to reduce costs, and IT will play a crucial role in this endeavor while improving patient outcomes and quality of care. It will be intriguing to see how cloud computing will help solve these issues and make contributions to healthcare commerce. The effort of this document is to analyze the present-day condition and developments of cloud-based computing in the field of healthcare.

articleTitle: Enhancing Medical Images with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs): A Review of Techniques and Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have demonstrated substantial utility in the domain of synthetic image generation for medical imaging. There are several obstacles to the growing need for high-quality photographs for illness detection, including expense, time, and radiation exposure. Generative adversarial networks have found applications in various image-to-image translation tasks such as virtual reconstruction of 7T MRIs from 3T images, enhancing low-quality resolution images into higher quality ones, and similar converting CT scans to MRIs. By creating multimodal datasets from a single modality, these methods greatly enhance data quality and eliminate the need for repeated scans. This paper examines several GAN models and how they are used in medical image processing, emphasizing how they may improve picture quality for more accurate diagnosis.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Machine Learning-Based Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: In this work comprehensive research on the prevention of network threats, with a primary focus on Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS). The research aims to detect and classify intrusions that compromise information integrity, availability, and confidentiality (privacy). The research leverages ML(Machine learning) models for intrusion detection and classification employing algorithms like Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Logistic Regression to increase dependability and efficiency. The models are evaluated on benchmark datasets, including KDD99, CSE-CIC-IDS2018 and UNSW-NB15, utilizing key features to improve performance and achieve better comparative results. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of ML models in achieving high detection rates while maintaining robustness against diverse attack vectors. This work offers actionable insights for the integration of ML-based systems into modern cybersecurity frameworks, paving the way for intelligent, automated, and proactive threat management solutions.

articleTitle: Skin Microbiome as a Diagnostic Tool for Atopic Dermatitis in Children and Adults
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Atopic Dermatitis (AD) is a multifactorial, chronic inflammatory skin disorder, often marked by repeated occurrences of itchy and eczematous lesions. While it often manifests in childhood, it can persist into adulthood with varying severity and immune response. Studies have often suggested the role of genetic, microbial, and immune system alteration in the progression of the disease. Microbial dysbiosis associated with increased Staphylococcus colonization is often suggested to be the prime reason for inflammatory lesions. In this study, we illustrate a univariate statistics approach to formulate a microbial index panel for effective and early diagnosis of Atopic Dermatitis in children and adults. We observed a significant increase in the prevalence of Staphylococcus and Streptococcus. We obtained a 43-genera microbial signature for diagnosing lesion skin Atopic Dermatitis in children with an area under receiver operating curve (AUROC) of 0.8 and an accuracy of 89.47% on a validation set using a random forest classifier. The specificity of this model was found around 60% and sensitivity was approximated to 100%. This model included genera like Pseudomonas, Kyptococcus, Sphignomonas, Lawsonella, and Aliicoccus alongside various others. In the case of adults, a set of three genera Staphylococcus, Lawsonella, and Corynebacterium obtained using the RFECV feature selector and gradient boosting classifier provided an AUROC of 0.85 and an accuracy of 85.71 %. Although additional studies in diverse cohorts are required with a greater sample size, our findings may provide new insights for developing new biomarkers in screening patients with AD besides providing an insight into new therapeutic interventions and personalized medicine in treating AD.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Network Effects and Tokenization for Next-Gen Communication Networks in Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The decentralization of energy systems, driven by rapid adoption of renewable energy sources, has posed new challenges in communication, data sharing, and energy trading. Traditional grid structures rarely cope with the fast-changing dynamics of distributed generation resources (DERs), thus demanding smarter and scalable communication networks and mechanisms of synchronizing and optimizing operations. The set of technologies on AI-driven and tokenization-like approaches practically allows for the change. AI-driven networks support this by enabling real-time decision-making and predictive analytics through smart energy distribution and demand forecasting and massively automated grid optimization. Tokenization, reinforced by blockchain technologies, allows the decentralization of energy trading through transparent peer-to-peer (P2P) transactions that ease the encumbrances of the traditional utility. The paper focuses on how AI-driven networks and tokenization integrate to form the future communication networks in energy systems. It highlights their contribution to improving grid efficiency, securing grid infrastructure, diminishing operational costs, and democratizing energy markets. Additionally, it discusses technical challenges, regulatory barriers, and long-term implications while looking ahead and thinking about how these innovations can be used to reorganize energy infrastructures all over the globe and rapidly quicken the shift to decentralized sustainable energy ecosystems.

articleTitle: Coalescing the Use of Emotional Intelligence in the Digital Era
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: The extensive rise of digital technology has had a significant impact on all aspects of human contact, communication, and decision-making. Emotional Intelligence (EI) is becoming exclusively important as digital platforms and automated systems are gaining traction in both professional and personal settings. Emotional intelligence (EI) has improved decision-making, teamwork in virtual environments, and human-computer relationships, among other things. This book chapter examines into how Emotional Intelligence meets the digital age. The chapter finds how emotional intelligence (EI) is applied in various digital situations, including remote employment, social media, and AI-powered customer service. It emphasizes on the significance of being emotionally aware and compassionate in a digital world that is often perceived as cold and impersonal. The chapter discusses the challenges of implementing emotional intelligence (EI) in online interactions due to the absence of nonverbal cues and traditional interpersonal feedback mechanisms. It explores methods for building EI in online contexts, including adaptive learning algorithms, virtual emotional training, and embedding EI into AI systems. The chapter emphasizes the interdependence of EI and digital competencies, emphasizing its importance for successful leadership, connection building, and meaningful communication in the virtualized world. It offers insights to improve digital interactions and create a more emotionally intelligent society.

articleTitle: Harnessing the Adoption of HR Analytics in IT Firms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Cognitive Computing in Engineering, Communications, Sciences and Biomedical Health Informatics (IC3ECSBHI)
abstract: Human resources has undergone substantial transformation in recent decades. The initial administrative role of human resources has transformed into a strategic and datadriven function focused on attaining company objectives. HR analytics has become increasingly significant as a tool for modern enterprises. Workforce attributes such as employer behavior, performance, and engagement can be evaluated, analyzed, and understood using data and statistical methods in HR analytics. Organizations may enhance their hiring, retention, employee development, and overall performance by leveraging data to gain valuable information about their staff. The ability to analyze and comprehend the growing volume of data available to businesses has become crucial for achieving economic success.
